name: Monster Hunter Stories Deluxe Collection
storyline: The first game tells the story of a rider who confronts a calamity known as the Black Blight that has overtaken the world, all while learning to live together with hunters. The second game is set four years later, when a new hero unravels the epic story surrounding a legendary Rathalos, one foretold to bring ruin to the world.
summary:
Both Monster Hunter Stories games are included in one deluxe collection!

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series that takes the world of Monster Hunter and expands upon it in new and exciting ways! No longer are you hunting monsters, but raising them! Featuring heroes known as Monster Riders, you will live alongside monsters and form lifelong bonds with them.
